message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration, a magazine cover, features a muscular, three-headed giant and a much smaller figure. The giant has a large torso, thick arms, and one leg visible with dark, crisscrossing straps. Each head is a light-skinned male with dark hair; the central head wears round-rimmed glasses, and the right head wears rectangular glasses. The giant wears a dark sleeveless garment and a belt with a gold oval buckle containing a stylized red "H" or infinity-shaped logo. The giant’s right arm is raised, flexing, while the left arm reaches forward with an open hand toward the small figure.

The small figure, a light-skinned male with dark hair, stands with his back to the viewer, wearing a white sleeveless tunic. He holds a dark sling, pulled back and ready to fire. Both figures are positioned against a red and orange gradient background.

At the top, "TEMPO" is printed in large white serif letters. Above it, a blue bar contains yellow text: "Investigasi: Bisnis Gula dan Kepentingan Istana". Small black text reads "EDISI 3 - 9 Maret 2003". Large yellow text in the center reads "Raksasa Lippo Menyerah?". A barcode and small text are at the bottom.
